subject: Mutual Action Plan: Performance onboarding & test windows for SignalWave
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@signalwave.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Performance MAP kickoff + target SLAs

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the intro call earlier — were excited to move to a formal MAP so we can validate Redwoods latency and concurrency guarantees before we finalize the Dedicated commitment. High level asks from SignalWave:

- TTFT (time-to-first-token) <= 800ms p50 for short instructions (<=128 tokens)
- Token latency p95 <= 1200ms at baseline concurrency (200 concurrent sessions)
- Sustained throughput: 1,000 requests/sec for inference path (median payload ~80 tokens)
- Concurrency scalability to 500 sessions with graceful degradation and documented fallback behavior

Wed also like a plan for load windows (we prefer US evening windows: Jan 20–22, 22:00–02:00 UTC), service account keys for the test env, and a small corpus of production-like prompt sets (I attached a quick requirements doc). Security/compliance folks will need network/E2E encryption details and a logging sample for audit.

Attaching: signalwave_requirements_v1.pdf

Best,
Emma
Product Ops, SignalWave

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@signalwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance MAP kickoff + target SLAs

Hi Emma — thanks, this is clear and helpful.

We propose the following MAP milestones and logistics so we can align engineering & infra before the load windows you suggested: 

1) Jan 16: MAP doc + test plan shared (we will capture TTFT/latency/throughput targets and success criteria)
2) Jan 17–18: Pre-load sanity runs in our staging (lowramp) to validate keys and routing
3) Jan 20–22: Full load windows (22:00–02:00 UTC each night) with progressive ramping to 1k RPS and a final stress to 1.5k RPS for 30m on the 22nd
4) Jan 23: Post-test results + follow-up report and recommended config changes (batching, quantization profile, cache hints)

Can Rishi and Neha confirm availability for the 17–22 window? Vanessa, Ill need your team to sign off on quota for the dedicated pool and to enable the KV prefix cache for the runs.

Im attaching the MAP spreadsheet (signalwave_map_v1.xlsx) and the test-env instructions — the latter contains the service account naming convention and ephemeral key TTLs. Ill provision the first set of keys once I get your confirmation on the test window and the list of test accounts.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: signalwave_map_v1.xlsx; test_env_access_instructions.txt

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-16T08:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance MAP kickoff + target SLAs

Jasmine — quick technical note on targets and measurement so were consistent: 

- Measurement harness: we will use the Redwood perf-harness v2 with the same tokenization & sampling settings you use in prod (deterministic top-k=50 for baseline).
- TTFT definition: time from request acceptance to first byte on the websocket/stream (well report p50/p90/p95).
- Load profile: synthetic mix = 70% simple prompts (~40 tokens), 20% medium (~120 tokens), 10% long (~512 tokens). Well include KV-cache and no-cache runs to show delta.
- Concurrency: well simulate session stickiness; concurrency=number of simultaneous sessions holding KV cache entries.

Ill own the harness and run the pre-load sanity checks on Jan 17 at 14:00 UTC. Expect a short report by EOD.

—Rishi
Senior Perf Eng, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-17T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance MAP kickoff + target SLAs

Thanks — security checklist items we need from SignalWave before we hand over keys:

- List of test IPs / CIDR ranges that will be used for the load generators (we will allowlist)
- Confirmation that test payloads will not include PII (or that PII is redacted)
- Contact for SOC/compliance (we will provide a sample audit log and retention policy)

Ill provision ephemeral service account keys (TTL=6 hours) once these are provided. Also, we require that load generators authenticate via TLS mutual auth during the stress windows.

-Neha
SecOps Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Chen <oliver@signalwave.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Emma Park <emma@signalwave.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T15:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance MAP kickoff + target SLAs

Jasmine — thanks for the plan. Quick responses from SignalWave infra:

- Test runners: we will run k6 runners from three cloud regions (us-east1, us-west1, us-central1). IP ranges attached.
- Payloads: Emma confirmed well sanitize PII and provide representative prompt sets.
- Contact: Oliver Chen (me) for infra; SOC contact is Maya R. (maya.r@signalwave.com).

We accept the Jan 20–22 windows. Can you share the service account names and the expected header format so our runners can be configured?

Oliver
Platform Eng, SignalWave

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@signalwave.com>, Emma Park <emma@signalwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance MAP kickoff + target SLAs

Oliver — thanks, added Maya to the compliance list.

Service account naming convention: redwood-signalwave-test-{region}-{runid} (we will create redwood-signalwave-test-use1-01 initially). Attached test_env_access_instructions.txt has the header example and ephemeral key fetch endpoint. Keys will be issued with TTL=6h and scoped to inference:predict and logs:read.

Quick run plan for Jan 20 (detailed schedule in MAP sheet):
- 22:00 UTC – baseline ramp to 250 RPS (10m soak)
- 22:15 UTC – ramp to 1,000 RPS over 20m (measure p50/p90/p95 TTFT & token latency)
- 22:45 UTC – hold 1,000 RPS for 45m (collect throughput, error rates)
- 23:30 UTC – ramp to 1,500 RPS for 30m (stress; record graceful degradation / fallback)

We will stream live metrics to the shared Grafana dashboard and hold a short checkpoint call at 23:10 UTC each night to confirm progress. Rishi will publish the harness config and expected result CSV schema in the Drive link.

Attachments: test_env_access_instructions.txt

Regards,
Jasmine

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@signalwave.com>, Emma Park <emma@signalwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-22T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance MAP kickoff + target SLAs — final results snapshot

Team — closing the MAP with a short summary and next steps following the Jan 20–22 runs. Key highlights (full CSV attached: sw_bench_results_20260121.csv):

- TTFT: p50=680ms, p90=930ms, p95=1,120ms on baseline 1,000 RPS with caching enabled. Met SignalWave p50 TTFT <=800ms.
- Token latency p95: 1,180ms for median payloads; marginally above the 1,200ms threshold for long sequences under sustained stress.
- Throughput: stable 1,050 RPS sustained during the 45m hold; error rate 0.4% (mostly 429s during the 1,500 RPS stress bursts).
- Concurrency behavior: maintained session KV cache for up to 420 concurrent sessions without measurable TTL churn; degraded gracefully above 450 sessions with increased 429s and queueing.

Recommendations: two quick config moves for production onboarding — enable a conservative request-level batching policy and increase soft concurrency cap to 500 with a documented fallback to a smaller model variant for >500 sessions. Well produce a full MAP closure doc that includes the raw CSV, Grafana links, and suggested Dedicated capacity commit levels.

Next steps:
- Jan 24: Delivery of full report and canary rollout checklist
- Jan 26: Executive sync for pricing/commitment (sales + SignalWave leadership)

Thanks everyone — attaching the CSV and final MAP workbook.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sw_bench_results_20260121.csv; signalwave_map_v1.xlsx
